top_choice_rationale: The lattice clock rests on a simple, general and attributable mechanism: Katori's magic-wavelength condition cancels the differential light shift while Lamb-Dicke confinement removes Doppler and recoil shifts, and Ye's work took many-atom interrogation to the 10^-18 level. It is independently reproduced across several laboratories and has produced millimetre-scale redshift tests and bounds on varying constants. The two-name allocation is uncontested, and the citation is scoped to the lattice concept and its realisation rather than to later refinement. The reservations (third metrology prize, Ye as repeat laureate, unverified Sr-lattice priority history) are real but do not outweigh this. P002 is a mature and genuine invention but an enabling instrument, and it leaves the STEM corrector strand uncredited, so I rank it second, above no award.
